Cucurbitaceae.key_door: alternate palmate leaf + lateral tendril + unisexual flowers + inferior ovary → pepo/berry

Apodanthaceae.key_door: achlorophyllous endoparasite hidden inside legume stem; tiny flowers/fruits erupt through bark

lineage_lesson: Cucurbitales demonstrates extreme morphological divergence: ordinary green tendril-bearing gourds and a leafless endoparasite can still share a common order.
taxonomy_notes: Cucurbita melopepo is currently accepted by Kew; historical C. pepo var. melopepo maps to C. melopepo.
Cucumis melo is introduced in Texas under current Kew.
Pilostyles thurberi is accepted and native in Texas.
guardrails: Family/genus recognition only; no species promotion.
Do not infer native status from wild occurrence in Cucumis or cultivated Cucurbita.
Do not mistake Pilostyles flowers for galls/fungi without checking host-stem reproductive structures.
